commands.title: Inspect published assets and review notes
commands.inputs: Selected library, cached index, and publication evidence.
commands.outputs: JSON asset facts; build and serve produce offline previews.
commands.mutation: Status, inspect and list read data. Build writes cache. Notes commands write authored review data.
commands.build: No Cargo build. Use the owner Python environment.

commands.title: Prepare assets for a world, room, or character
commands.inputs: Authored world units, prepared content bindings, and producer declarations.
commands.outputs: Scoped product requirements, availability, and exact repair commands.
commands.mutation: Planning reads data. --generate-missing publishes only completely missing required products.
commands.build: Build the content check binary once. Asset repair does not invoke Cargo.
